name: 2-in-1 USB Galaxy Star Projector Night Light | 6 Projection Lenses | Adjustable Brightness Starry Sky & Night Lamp
description:
Create a relaxing and dreamy atmosphere in your room with this 2-in-1 USB Galaxy Star Projector Night Light. Designed with both a starry sky projector and night light function, it transforms dark indoor spaces with beautiful projection effects while providing gentle illumination. The compact projector features 6 interchangeable projection lenses, allowing you to switch between different visual effects according to your preference. Its USB-powered design makes it convenient to use with a power bank, laptop, USB adapter, or other compatible USB power source. The darker the room, the more impressive the projection effect becomes. Ideal for bedrooms, children's rooms, home décor, KTV spaces, and relaxing environments, this mini projector adds a unique decorative touch while creating a calming nighttime atmosphere.
